final_description: QA Agent — LLM-as-judge that grades a scraper test/repair attempt against the run's mission (met/partial/reason). No browser at run time.
Scrape Executor — runs a generated, self-contained scraper script (contract v2) against a browser session and returns the extracted case-detail fields or the error. No AI at run time.

Scrape Generator — drives a court website from a case number to the case-detail page, then emits a self-contained, parametrized scraper script (standard contract) that a downstream executor runs blindly at scale.
Site Analyst — autonomously probes a court website and produces a site briefing (login, search, blockers, navigation flow, field locations) for a downstream extraction agent.

Scraper Orchestrator — entry point of the scraper authoring plane. Routes analyst -> generator -> Executor, owns the generate/test/repair loop and error_history, and emits a live orchestration DAG (plan/steps/events). No browser, no LLM.
Turns meeting transcripts into Excel or Word BRDs
Case classification agent for PACER. Takes a CSV file of court cases, processes them in batches, scrapes case documents, annotates PDFs and classifies each case (legal discovery).
Document authoring agent for generating structured documents like BRDs, PRDs, and SRSs from unstructured text and user prompts.

Scrape Monitor — diagnoses a repeatedly-failing court scraper from its errors and failure screenshots, decides whether re-authoring will help (vs. anti-bot/transient), and drives the orchestrator to regenerate the script, returning the fresh script to the caller.
Tracking Top Talent Across the Universe of Candidates. Takes a resume and a job description (PDF/DOCX) and evaluates how well the candidate matches the job.
Generates training document from aCT-recorded Output
Executes recorded UI automation scripts as a test suite and returns an HTML report
Daily birthday & work-anniversary card bot for Microsoft Teams
Supply chain risk orchestrator. Consumes Trade Compliance and Supplier Performance reports, enriches with external risk signals, scores/ranks suppliers, and generates guardrail-gated action plans.

Generates a concise, business-readable project insight report: fetches the Jira scope live for a chosen date range, exports every examined ticket to a tracking CSV, compares against the stored baseline snapshot, charts the created-vs-resolved trend, and produces a short Word (.docx) report.
Aetherion agent that prioritizes a Jira dashboard daily and produces a downloadable Word brief
Extracts a candidate profile directly from a resume, independent of any job description.

Generates automated UI tests from a codebase: analyzes a frontend GitHub repository, writes Playwright end-to-end tests for it, and pushes them as a new branch to a separate automation/test repository. Inputs: frontend repo URL, automation repo URL, GitHub token.
Enter your email to instantly see every known breach where your data was compromised.
Turns a rough email draft or notes into a polished, ready-to-send email.
General-purpose chatbot. The user types any free-form question or query and the chatbot replies with an answer in conversation. No files or special inputs; use only when no specialised agent fits.

Invoice data extraction agent (Intelligent Document Recognition). Upload invoices as PDF or ZIP; a vision model (fine-tuned Qwen3-VL) reads them and extracts the invoice fields. Optionally compares results side-by-side with the base model for accuracy, and can write the extracted invoices to a downloadable CSV report.

Creates and emails a news digest on a chosen topic: finds the latest news for a time range, summarizes the top N stories in a chosen summary style, optionally adds images, and emails it to a recipient or mailing list with a custom subject.
Turns meeting notes plus meeting details (title, date, attendees) into a summary of the meeting and its action items, delivered as a PDF document.
Generates an image from a text prompt, with generation options such as style, size or number of images.
